blockers.description: The official model repository requires accepted gated access for authoritative card and artifact bytes.
No checkpoint byte SHA-256 is available and repository revision is not a substitute.

uma-gated-artifact-tree.rationale: Checkpoint and reference-configuration bytes remain gated and are never downloaded, opened, inspected, or loaded.
uma-gated-artifact-tree.title: Gated UMA weights and reference YAML files

uma-gated-model-card.rationale: The raw card requires gated access and was not retrieved.
uma-gated-model-card.title: Gated UMA model card

uma-public-api-metadata.title: Public Hugging Face UMA repository metadata

limitations: Only a public metadata response is recorded.
No model-card body, reference configuration, checkpoint byte hash, or model execution evidence exists.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

uma-gated-card-unavailable.description: The raw model card and reference configuration bodies were unavailable without gated access.

uma-weight-hashes-unavailable.description: No checkpoint bytes or artifact byte hashes were retrieved; repository revision is insufficient.

uma.model.artifact.gated.statement: The public repository metadata reports a gated model repository; the FairChem framework source identity does not establish UMA weight bytes.
uma.model.artifact.gated.title: UMA gated model-artifact boundary

uma.model.card.blocked.statement: The raw gated model card was unavailable without accepted access terms, so task/domain/license claims remain incomplete.
uma.model.card.blocked.title: UMA model-card evidence

uma.model.names.metadata.statement: Public metadata enumerates uma-m-1p1.pt, uma-s-1.pt, uma-s-1p1.pt, uma-s-1p2.pt and uma-s-1p2p1.pt as names only; no artifact bytes are included.
uma.model.names.metadata.title: UMA checkpoint-name metadata

uma.reference.yaml.blocked.statement: Gated reference YAML files are not retrieved; provider defaults, heads, element references and task settings remain unresolved.
uma.reference.yaml.blocked.title: UMA reference configuration evidence

uma.repository.gated.statement: facebook/UMA is manually gated; public metadata does not authorize access to or redistribution of gated model-card and artifact bytes.
uma.repository.gated.title: UMA gated-access state

uma.repository.identity.statement: The public API reported repository revision f611b917d9c68566bbbeccbb0aa0f7cad1696cb2 at retrieval time.
uma.repository.identity.title: UMA model-repository revision

uma.weight.byte.identity.blocked.statement: A repository revision is not a checkpoint byte SHA-256; no weight byte hash was acquired, and weights are never downloaded, opened, or loaded.
uma.weight.byte.identity.blocked.title: UMA weight-byte identity
